einzeiler: Matt Perrault takes a betting break after a cold streak and shares top football futures.
kurzfassung: After suffering a brutal losing streak through July and August, Matt Perrault is taking a day off from betting to recalibrate his bankroll. Instead of daily picks, he shares three season-long future bets for the upcoming football season. His analysis covers win totals for the Patriots and Bills in the NFL, as well as a college football win total for UNLV.
stichpunkte: Matt Perrault takes a betting hiatus after missing eleven consecutive bets and enduring a cold July and August.
Emphasizes strict bankroll management, advising against chasing losses with reckless parlays.
Relies on successful future wagers historically to salvage slumping bankrolls at the end of sports seasons.
Presents the first NFL future: New England Patriots over 9.5 wins, projecting a 10-7 or 11-6 finish.
Argues that the Patriots' roster improvements in the secondary and wide receiver room are currently undervalued by the market.
Presents the second NFL future: Buffalo Bills under 11.5 wins, citing a tough schedule and a first-year head coach.
Presents the college football future: UNLV Rebels over 8.5 wins, backed by a favorable schedule and star recruit quarterbacking.
Announces a modified podcast release schedule for the upcoming travel week.
